hooks.name: Enforce future annotations import
hooks.description: After saving any Python file, warns if it is missing the required 'from __future__ import annotations' header mandated by the project rules.

action.command: f=$(python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$f" ] && [ -s "$f" ] && ! grep -q "from __future__ import annotations" "$f"; then echo "WARNING: $f is missing 'from __future__ import annotations' (project rule)"; fi
